description: This file contains inline utility functions for file content reading, property extraction, file type checking, directory searching, and variable expansion within strings, all within the 'Utils' namespace. It is part of a larger C++ project and provides helper functions for file and string operations.

methods.name: readPropertyFromFile
methods.description: Reads a property value from a specified file, with support for recursive expansion if the property value starts with '$'.

methods.name: readFileContent
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a string.

methods.name: isRegularFile
methods.description: Checks if a given path corresponds to a regular file.

methods.name: searchFilesRec
methods.description: Recursively searches directories for files matching patterns, with exclusions and result cap.

methods.name: searchFiles
methods.description: Initiates recursive directory search with specified depth and exclusions.

methods.name: ExpandPropertiesInString
methods.description: Expands variables within a string by replacing them with property values read from a file.
